name: Backend: project dependencies model + related-project search scope
description:
GOAL
Make "Project dependencies" a first-class backend concept and make information search cover the current project, its child projects and its linked dependency projects.

CONTEXT (verified in the code)
- api/codx/junior/settings.py -> CODXJuniorSettings.project_dependencies: Optional[str] stores a comma separated list of PROJECT NAMES. It MUST stay backward compatible (client/src/store/project.js and existing .codx/project.json files read/write the string).
- settings.py get_project_dependencies() (~line 735) splits on commas without strip/dedupe, and nothing ever resolves those names to real projects.
- api/codx/junior/project/project_discover.py already provides find_project_by_name(), is_path_child_of() and get_project_dependencies(settings). Import them LAZILY inside the methods: project_discover imports settings.py, a module-level import would be circular.
- api/codx/junior/engine/knowledge_engine.py has get_project_dependencies() (children via settings.get_sub_projects() + names via find_project_by_name) and get_all_search_projects().

DO
1) settings.py
   - Add next to project_dependencies:
     search_related_projects: Optional[bool] = Field(default=True, description="Search the knowledge, wiki and file indexes of child and dependency projects too")
   - get_dependency_names() -> List[str]: split on ",", strip each name, drop empties, dedupe preserving order.
   - get_project_dependencies(): keep the name for compatibility, delegate to get_dependency_names().
   - get_dependency_projects() -> List[CODXJuniorSettings]: resolve each name in this order: (a) find_project_by_name(name), (b) sibling folder os.path.join(os.path.dirname(self.abs_project_path), name), (c) an absolute path, (d) a folder inside the project os.path.join(self.abs_project_path, name). A candidate is valid only if <folder>/.codx/project.json exists; load it with CODXJuniorSettings.from_project_file. Skip and log a warning for names that do not resolve; dedupe by codx_path and never return the project itself.
   - get_related_projects(include_children=True, include_dependencies=True) -> List[CODXJuniorSettings]: children (get_sub_projects() when include_children) + dependencies (get_dependency_projects() when include_dependencies), deduped by codx_path, self excluded; returns [] when search_related_projects is False.
2) Search scope
   - knowledge_engine.get_project_dependencies()/get_all_search_projects(): build the list from settings.get_related_projects() (self first) and keep honouring knowledge_query_subprojects for the children part.
   - Find every other place that enumerates settings.get_sub_projects() for SEARCH purposes (start with api/codx/junior/search/project_search_manager.py, api/codx/junior/engine/wiki_engine.py, api/codx/junior/wiki/) and switch it to get_related_projects(), keeping the existing flags (wiki_search_children, knowledge_query_subprojects).

CONSTRAINTS
- Small, reviewable diff; English docstrings; no reformatting of untouched code.
- Never change the persisted format of project_dependencies.

ACCEPTANCE
- CODXJuniorSettings(project_dependencies=" a , b,,a ").get_dependency_names() == ["a", "b"].
- With project_dependencies pointing at an existing project name, get_dependency_projects() returns that project; an unknown name is skipped with a warning instead of raising.
- get_related_projects() excludes self and duplicates, and returns [] when search_related_projects is False.
- `python -c "from codx.junior.settings import CODXJuniorSettings"` works (no circular import).
